# Dr3amy Pages

> Dr3amy Pages — static, small, yours.

Dr3amy Pages is a browser-based static HTML publishing platform.
Users can create pages from templates or custom HTML and publish
them using their own GitHub repositories.

## Website

https://dr3amy.creepers.pro/

## Features

- Create and publish static HTML pages
- Start with built-in templates
- Edit HTML directly in the browser
- Store published pages in GitHub repositories
- Access published pages through public URLs

## How It Works

1. Open the Dr3amy Pages dashboard.
2. Connect a GitHub repository.
3. Create a page using a template or custom HTML.
4. Publish the page.
5. Access the published page through its public URL.
